scripts.dev: pnpm wasm:build && concurrently --kill-others --names server,web "cargo run -p sdr-server" "pnpm --filter @sdr-lab/web dev"
scripts.wasm:setup: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.100 --locked
scripts.lint:check: prettier --check . && eslint . --max-warnings=0 && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.quality:check: pnpm check-types && pnpm lint:check && pnpm test
scripts.build: pnpm wasm:build && pnpm --filter @sdr-lab/web build && cargo build -p sdr-server --release
